<details class="nhsuk-details">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">Text description of this diagram</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

| Step | Where you are | What you do | What you produce |
|---|--------------|--------------------|--------------------|
| 1 | The critical friend What you are confirming | You give independent advice. You are not delivering the analysis. | Nothing recorded yet. |
| 2 | The critical friend Independence | The separation follows the level, from a colleague to external review. | Your name on the design and plan, before work starts. |
| 3 | Phase 2 Design | Review the plan. Confirm the approach and assurance level are right. | A reviewed assurance plan, and your time in the schedule. |
| 4 | The checks, by level | Run the checks the level asks for, and the levels inside it. | Your entries in the quality assurance log. |
| 5 | Phase 3 Analysis | You shall review the analyst's assurance and report errors and improvements back. | Your findings, and the analyst's response to each one. |
| 6 | R9 Uncertainty | Check assumptions are traceable, and uncertainty quantified where the method allows. | A recorded view on whether uncertainty is handled adequately. |
| 7 | Phase 4 Delivery, communication and sign-off | State the assurance: appropriately scoped, executed, validated, verified and documented. | The quality assurance statement, or your part of it. |

: The critical friend's journey, step by step

A second note, **after the last step:** What you report back is what the next piece of work avoids.

</div>
</details>
